scope: Descriptive regression of rejected original v46 on all 350 previously consumed Mac sources, using its original historical English threshold. No calibration, threshold rescue, training change or deployment.
calibration_role: Original historical English report, viable_operating_point false; not an eligible joint-gate calibration
expected_measurement: Retain every original source, frontend array, two reset replays and complete UINT8 outputs. Report all voice/variant target, shared-negative and cross-target counts for original v46, original v30 and retained Hi ESP. No success threshold or candidate selection is introduced.
limits: Old rejected model and reused correlated synthetic data only. Do not infer fresh human, matched-FAR, latency, P4 or acoustic acceptance; no new/final data, audio I/O or board operation. The current GPU matched formal experiment and its original gates remain unchanged.
